result.brief: 提出纹理空间表面动态嵌入与编码器-解码器表征，将姿态相关动态编码为动态纹理图并解码为3D高斯，实现静态化身到可控4D化身的生成。
result.reason: Generates pose-dependent dynamic texture maps decoded to 3D Gaussians for 4D avatars; representation contribution for dynamic human modeling, though primarily avatar/4D application rather than video world model.
